set.body: Acceptance: static Aoi values have validated identity/label, Frame identity plus specification, Region geometry, and attributes; AoiSet rejects duplicate IDs and frame conflicts; overlap behavior is an explicit MembershipPolicy (Multiple, ExclusiveByPriority, SmallestContaining, RejectOverlap); assignment retains background and excluded support; measurements return dwell duration/proportion, first-entry latency, run count, and transition counts with represented-time accounting; overlapping-AOI, boundary, duplicate-ID, wrong-frame, duplicated-mass, and dropped-background mutants fail on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Golden workflow: frame-bound static AOIs and accounting-safe measures
